Resolves #21745

A drag that starts in a scrolled board column now leaves the column where it was scrolled to: through the drag, after a cancel, and after a drop out of a sliced column at its end. Two causes, two fixes:

- `SortZone#beginColumnSort` placed the cards at box-relative tops with `scrollTop` 0, so the scrolled body's content collapsed and the browser clamped. The rects now go into the body's content space, the sort reads the body's `scrollTop` (one `DomAccess.getAttributes` read beside the rects), and the cards root keeps its in-flow height as a `min-height` until `restoreColumn`. The root is not a spacer, so a sliced column's mid-drag projection (`Column#updateSpacers`) leaves the pin alone.
- `DeltaUpdates#flushLayoutHeals` toggles a `moveBefore()` parent's `display` and forces a layout. It restored the parent's own scroll offset, not a scrolled ancestor's: the board body around the cards root clamped to one window above its end. The heal now captures and restores the ancestor chain (O(depth), no subtree scan).

Evidence: L3 (real-browser Playwright e2e and component runs, local Chromium) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-3 are browser scroll behaviour). Residual: none.

| AC-2 | CI-covered: `e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs` "a drop out of a windowed column scrolled to its end…"; the heal alone: `component/container/LayoutHealBatching.spec.mjs` "a heal leaves a scrolled ancestor…" |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: red-first in a base worktree at dev `cca960d9cd`, table below |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: board unit, component and e2e families |

## Deltas from ticket
- AC-2 needed a second fix outside the board, in `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs`: the drop-side cause, the one-window jump the ticket's defect-note named.
- `min-height` on the cards root rather than a bottom-spacer filler. Nothing else writes the root, so the spacer rewrite during a sliced drag cannot undo it.
- The board unit harness now stubs `DomAccess.getAttributes` and gives each cards root the id a render would. Until now `root(...)` compared `undefined` with `undefined`.

## Test Evidence
Red-first: the head's specs run in a base worktree.

| Spec | dev `cca960d9cd` | intermediate arm | head |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inbox, drag + Escape | 2560 → 0 | 2560 → 2548 (content-space rects, no pin) | 2560 kept |
| sliced Ready, drag + Escape | 2211 → 1256 | 2211 → 2199 (same arm) | 2211 kept |
| sliced Ready, drop at its end | 907 px above the end | 907 px above the end (zone fix, no heal fix) | at the end |
| heal under a scrolled ancestor | 700 → 0 | n/a | 700 kept |

How the heal was found: wrapping the body's `scrollTop` setter caught no write, so the jump was a clamp. A `MutationObserver` with `attributeOldValue` then showed `display: none` → `''` on the cards root inside the drop's batch.

The board unit specs (62 passed), `LayoutHealBatching` (5) and the board e2e specs `MultiSelect` and `BasicNL` (31) pass on this content, run before #21731 landed; #21731 adds only a scheduler example.

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket #21745 (including its `Design authority:` citation to `Neo.board.Column#selectWindow` and handover comment `IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABpLC5qQ`), changed-file list (`src/board/SortZone.mjs`, `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs`, and 5 Playwright unit/component/e2e specs), current `dev` source of `src/board/SortZone.mjs`, `src/board/Column.mjs`, `src/board/ColumnBody.mjs`, `src/util/Style.mjs`, and `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs` (`moveNode` / `flushLayoutHeals`), plus 2 Memory Core prior-art sweeps.
